dim_date.table_description: Date dimension, from the start of the reporting window to the extraction date (no future date).

descriptions.head_employee_id: Head of department at the extraction date

dim_org_unit.table_description: Departments (grain of every fact) with their site. Target of the RLS filter.

descriptions.org_unit_ids_history: Departments where the employee worked or has a movement in the reporting window, '|id1|id2|' (RLS on this table)
descriptions.site_codes_history: Sites where the employee worked or has a movement in the reporting window, '|S100|S200|' (RLS on this table)

dim_employee.table_description: Employees (pseudonyms). current_org_unit_id = department at the extraction date (last department for leavers), used by the RLS filter on this table.

descriptions.level_label: Cadre, Agent de maîtrise, Employé / ouvrier

dim_absence_type.table_description: Absence types. counts_in_absenteeism separates the absenteeism rate from total absences (paid leave included).

descriptions.exit_category_label: French label of the exit category

dim_action_type.table_description: Personnel action type and reason, with the exit category.

descriptions.scope_value: '*', site code or department org unit id

sec_user_scope.table_description: RLS table: fictitious UPN to scope. Disconnected and hidden in the Power BI model.

descriptions.month_end_date: Last day of the month (or extraction date for a partial month)
descriptions.month_start: First day of the month (relationship key to dim_date)
descriptions.tenure_years: Years since the start of the current spell, at month end
descriptions.age_years: Age in completed years at month end
descriptions.age_band_order: Sort key of the age band

fct_headcount_monthly.table_description: End-of-month headcount snapshot (imported into Power BI). Stock measures are semi-additive: never sum across months.

descriptions.event_date: Movement date; for an exit, last worked day (BEGDA - 1)
descriptions.month_start: First day of the event month (relationship key to dim_date)
descriptions.movement_type: hire, rehire, exit, transfer_in, transfer_out, promotion, contract_change
descriptions.is_cdi_exit: Exit of a permanent contract (CDI) employee
descriptions.headcount_delta: +1 entry or transfer in, -1 exit or transfer out, 0 otherwise

fct_movements.table_description: Workforce movements in the reporting window: hires, rehires, exits (dated on the last worked day), transfers (one row out, one row in), promotions and contract changes. Department and contract are those of the event day (last worked day for an exit).

descriptions.month_start: First day of the month (relationship key to dim_date)
descriptions.working_days: Working days employed in the month

fct_worktime_monthly.table_description: Theoretical working time per employee, month and department: denominator of the absenteeism and total absence rates. Working days exclude weekends and metropolitan French public holidays; hours = WOSTD / 5 per working day.

descriptions.month_start: First day of the month (relationship key to dim_date)
descriptions.absence_days: Working days of absence in the month
descriptions.absence_hours: Hours of absence in the month

fct_absence_monthly.table_description: Absence hours per employee, month, department and absence type (working days only). Numerator of the absenteeism rate (types with counts_in_absenteeism) and of the total absence rate (all types, paid leave and RTT included).

descriptions.scope_value: ALL, site code or department org unit id
descriptions.scope_label: Entreprise, site name or department name
descriptions.month_end_date: Month end (or extraction date for a partial month)
descriptions.headcount_cdi: Active CDI employees at month end
descriptions.hires: Hires and rehires in the month
descriptions.exits: Exits in the month (last worked day in the month)
descriptions.female_share: Share of women at month end
descriptions.absence_hours_counted: Absence hours of the absenteeism types
descriptions.absence_hours_all: Absence hours of all types (paid leave and RTT included)
descriptions.total_absence_rate: Total absence rate of the month, paid leave and RTT included
descriptions.months_in_window: Months available in the trailing 12-month window
descriptions.avg_headcount_cdi_12m: Average of the 12 month-end CDI headcounts
descriptions.cdi_turnover_12m: Main KPI: CDI exits (all causes) over 12 months / average CDI headcount
descriptions.resignation_rate_12m: CDI resignations over 12 months / average CDI headcount
descriptions.total_exit_rate_12m: All exits (CDD and apprentices included) over 12 months / average headcount
descriptions.total_absence_rate_12m: Total absences (paid leave and RTT included) over the trailing 12 months

rpt_kpi_monthly.table_description: HR KPIs computed in SQL per month and scope (company, site, department). Reference for reconciling the Power BI DAX measures; definitions in docs/kpi-definitions.md. 12-month rates are NULL until 12 months of history are available.
